publications.name: Optimal Impulsive Maneuver Planning for Station Acquisition of Geosynchronous Satellites
publications.summary: Formulated station acquisition of geosynchronous satellites as an orbit reconfiguration problem using linearized relative oribital element dynamics and solved it using Differential Evolution followed by a constrained local optimization algorithm.

publications.name: Pore-scale reactive transport for assessing permeability changes on CO2 capture and storage
publications.summary: We developed a high fidelity 3D pore-scale reactive transport (PSRT) simulator using a generalized rate law that can be extended to any mineral for simulating the evolving pore geometry of a digital rock due to dissolution and precipitation reactions within the rock.
